meta.description: Sprint 5: publica via WhatsApp Business Cloud API. Respeita channel_rules, frequência e anti-spam.

parameters.query:
WITH settings AS (
  SELECT * FROM channel_settings WHERE channel = 'whatsapp' AND enabled = TRUE
),
today AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM publications
  WHERE channel = 'whatsapp' AND status = 'published' AND published_at::date = CURRENT_DATE
),
last_pub AS (
  SELECT MAX(published_at) AS ts FROM publications WHERE channel = 'whatsapp' AND status = 'published'
)
SELECT p.*,
  (SELECT content FROM publications WHERE product_id = p.id AND channel = 'whatsapp' AND status = 'draft' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS draft_content
FROM products p
CROSS JOIN settings s
CROSS JOIN today t
CROSS JOIN last_pub lp
WHERE p.active AND p.ai_publishable = TRUE
  AND p.opportunity_score >= COALESCE(($env.OPPORTUNITY_SCORE_THRESHOLD)::numeric, 70)
  AND t.cnt < s.max_posts_per_day
  AND (lp.ts IS NULL OR lp.ts < NOW() - (s.min_interval_minutes || ' minutes')::interval)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM channel_rules r
    WHERE r.source = p.source AND r.channel = 'whatsapp' AND r.allowed = TRUE
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM publications pub
    WHERE pub.product_id = p.id AND pub.channel = 'whatsapp' AND pub.status = 'published'
      AND pub.published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  )
ORDER BY p.opportunity_score DESC
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: WhatsApp Business Cloud
nodes.notes: Usar WhatsApp Business Platform/Cloud API — nunca WhatsApp Web automation.
